name: correctover-security-hook
description: Pre-tool-use security gate for Kimi Code: runs correctover-scan before file writes and MCP-related shell commands, and blocks the action (exit 2) on fail-level findings such as hardcoded live secrets, plaintext-HTTP MCP servers, or cloud-metadata SSRF targets.
author: Correctover

interface.shortDescription: Block Kimi Code writes/commands that contain live secrets, plaintext MCP transport, or SSRF targets — before they run.
interface.longDescription:
A PreToolUse hook that runs the open-source correctover-scan scanner before Kimi Code writes JS/TS files or runs MCP-related shell commands. It blocks the action (Kimi Code exit code 2) when the scanner reports fail-level findings — hardcoded live API keys, plaintext-HTTP MCP server URLs, cloud-metadata (169.254.169.254) SSRF targets, shell:true command execution, or dynamic eval primitives — and feeds the reason back to the model so it can fix the code and retry.

Scans run via `npx correctover-scan` (no API key for the free tier); scanner outages, timeouts, or quota exhaustion fail open and log to stderr, so a scanner problem never blocks your work. This is a reminder/light-gate layer, not your only security control — keep permission approvals and code review.

Zero-upload alternative for manual checks: https://correctover.com/scan.html
